items.slavonic_text: Припѣ́въ: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Ме́ртва четверодне́вна, въскри́сивъ Сп҃се мо́й Ла́зарѧ, тля̀ и҆змѣни́лъ є҆сѝ мы́шцею высо́кою, и҆ показа́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ си́лный вла́сть свою̀:. Въскли́кнꙋвъ Ла́зарѧ, и҆з гро́ба а҆́бїе въскр҃силъ є҆сѝ, но а҆́дъ до́лѣ го́рцѣ рыда́ше, и҆ стена́-[кустод: трепе-]
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* Let us all sing a song of victory unto God, Who hath wrought marvelous wonders with a high arm, and saved Israel, for He hath been glorified!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Прослези́лъ є҆сѝ Гдⷭ҇и на Ла́заремъ, пока́зꙋѧ въплоще́нїе смотре́нїѧ твоегѡ̀, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆стество́мъ Бг҃ъ сы́й, є҆стество́мъ по на́съ бы́лъ є҆сѝ чл҃къ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst weep over Lazarus, O Lord, manifesting the incarnation of Thy dispensation; and being God by nature, Thou didst become man by nature for our sake.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst weep over Lazarus, O Lord, manifesting the incarnation of Thy dispensation; and being God by nature, Thou didst become man by nature for our sake.

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Ма́рѳины сле́зы и҆ Марі́ины, оу҆толи́лъ є҆сѝ Гдⷭ҇и, и҆з ме́ртвыхъ Ла́зарѧ въскр҃си́въ Сп҃се, и҆ показа́въ ꙗ҆́кѡ нове́нна ме́ртваго, вла́стїи сѝ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst assuage the tears of Martha and Mary, O Lord, by raising Lazarus from the dead, O Savior, and by displaying Thy power over him that was dead as if newly slain.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst assuage the tears of Martha and Mary, O Lord, by raising Lazarus from the dead, O Savior, and by displaying Thy power over him that was dead as if newly slain.

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Зако́номъ є҆стества̀ чл҃ча въпроси́лъ є҆сѝ Вл҃ко, гдѣ̀ положе́нъ бы́сть Ла́зарь, пока́зꙋя всѣ̑мъ Сп҃се, прїи́скреннее є҆́же к на́мъ смотре́нїе твоѐ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* According to the law of human nature Thou didst inquire, O Master: "Where hath Lazarus been laid?" displaying unto all, O Savior, the reality of Thy dispensation toward us.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
According to the law of human nature Thou didst inquire, O Master: "Where hath Lazarus been laid?" displaying unto all, O Savior, the reality of Thy dispensation toward us.

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Заключе́нїѧ съкрꙋши́лъ є҆сѝ тогда̀ а҆́дова, къзггласи́ Ла́зара, и҆ держа́вꙋ сътря́слъ є҆сѝ вра́жїю, и҆ понꙋ́ди є҆сѝ пре́жде крⷵта̀, трепета́ти тебѐ Є҆ди́не Сп҃се:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst then shatter the bars of Hades, calling aloud unto Lazarus, and didst shake the enemy's dominion, compelling them even before the Cross to tremble before Thee, O only Savior!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst then shatter the bars of Hades, calling aloud unto Lazarus, and didst shake the enemy's dominion, compelling them even before the Cross to tremble before Thee, O only Savior!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Свя́зана Ла́зарѧ, ѿ а҆́да держи́маго Вл҃ко, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ предвари́лъ є҆сѝ и҆ разрѣши́лъ є҆сѝ ѿ оу҆́зъ, къ твое́мꙋ бо всѧ̑ си́лнѣ и҆дꙋ́тъ повелѣ́нїю:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Lazarus being bound and held fast by Hades, O Master, as God Thou didst anticipate and loose him that was bound from his bonds, for all things powerfully yield unto Thy command.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Lazarus being bound and held fast by Hades, O Master, as God Thou didst anticipate and loose him that was bound from his bonds, for all things powerfully yield unto Thy command.

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро: Непрело́жнѡ родила̀ є҆сѝ дв҃о Мт҃и, създа́телѧ є҆стествꙋ̀, ѿ ст҃гѡ Дх҃а по бл҃говоле́нїю Ѻ҆́тчꙋ бы́вша, є҆́же є҆смы̀ кро́мѣ и҆змѣне́нїѧ и҆ скве́рны:.
items.english_text: Glorify the Father, the Son, and the Spirit, the undivided Trinity in unity of nature; and with the angels let us praise Her as the one uncreated God!

provenance.verbatim_source: Glorify the Father, the Son, and the Spirit, the undivided Trinity in unity of nature; and with the angels let us praise Her as the one uncreated God!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва тѝ въскли́кнꙋвшомꙋ то́кмѡ, и҆ и҆з гро́ба ме́ртва четверодне́вна дрꙋ́га въздви́гшомꙋ Ла́зарѧ.
items.english_text: Without mutation hast thou given birth, O Virgin Mother, unto the Creator of nature, Who through the good pleasure of the Father became what we are through the Holy Spirit, without alteration and without defilement.

provenance.verbatim_source: Without mutation hast thou given birth, O Virgin Mother, unto the Creator of nature, Who through the good pleasure of the Father became what we are through the Holy Spirit, without alteration and without defilement.

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆слы́ша гла́са твоегѡ̀ бездꙋ́шный, и҆ ѡ҆дꙋшевленъ ѿ ме́ртвыхъ въста̀ а҆́бїе, сла́ва та̀ Гдⷭ҇и:.
items.english_text: *Ode 2. Heirmos:* Give ear, O heaven, and I will speak, and will sing in praise of Christ, the Savior of the world and the only Lover of mankind![^24]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 2. Heirmos:*
Give ear, O heaven, and I will speak, and will sing in praise of Christ, the Savior of the world and the only Lover of mankind![^24]

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Повелѣ́нїе живоно́снагѡ гла́са твоегѡ̀, прїи́мъ смердя́щїй въста̀ ѿ гро́ба сп҃се мо́й Ла́зарь:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Glory to Thee Who didst but call aloud, and didst raise up from the tomb Thy friend Lazarus, who was dead for four days!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Glory to Thee Who didst but call aloud, and didst raise up from the tomb Thy friend Lazarus, who was dead for four days!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Прослези́лъ є҆сѝ на дрꙋ́го Сп҃се мо́й, оу҆вѣря́я на́съ, ꙗ҆́коже но́силъ є҆сѝ є҆стество̀, и҆ сего̀ въскри́силъ є҆сѝ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The lifeless corpse heard Thy voice, and endowed with soul, straightway arose from the dead: glory to Thee, O Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The lifeless corpse heard Thy voice, and endowed with soul, straightway arose from the dead: glory to Thee, O Lord!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Въстрепета̀, ꙗ҆́коже ви́дѣ а҆́дъ па́ки текꙋ́ща а҆́бїе свя́зана оу҆кро́ими, гла́со к здѣ́шнемꙋ живо́тꙋ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Receiving the command of Thy life-bearing voice, my Savior, Lazarus arose from the tomb though he was stinking.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Receiving the command of Thy life-bearing voice, my Savior, Lazarus arose from the tomb though he was stinking.

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆жасо́шася Є҆вре́йстїи наро́ди, є҆гда̀ возгласи́ Сп҃се, въскри́силъ є҆сѝ сло́вомъ смердя́щаго Ла́зара:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst weep over Thy friend, O my Savior, giving us assurance that Thou didst bear our nature, even while raising him up.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst weep over Thy friend, O my Savior, giving us assurance that Thou didst bear our nature, even while raising him up.

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Сътрясо́шася сокро́вища а҆́дова, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѡ҆дꙋшевле́нъ бы́сть ни́зꙋ Ла́зарь, тогда̀ гла́со ѡ҆живи́вшагѡ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Hades trembled when it saw him that was bound in grave-bands running forth straightway at Thy voice unto life here on earth.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Hades trembled when it saw him that was bound in grave-bands running forth straightway at Thy voice unto life here on earth.

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, г҃. И҆рмо́съ. Ка́мень є҆го́же небрего́ша зи́ждꙋщїи, се́й бы́сть во главꙋ̀ оу҆́гла: се́й є҆́сть ка́мень, на не́мже оу҆твердѝ Хрⷭ҇то́съ Це́рковь свою̀, ю҆́же ѿ ꙗ҆зы̑къ и҆скꙋпи́.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Hebrew peoples were dismayed, O Savior, when Thou didst call aloud and raise by Thy word the stinking Lazarus.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The Hebrew peoples were dismayed, O Savior, when Thou didst call aloud and raise by Thy word the stinking Lazarus.

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Припѣ́въ: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The treasuries of Hades were shaken when Lazarus was quickened below at the voice of Him Who gives life.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The treasuries of Hades were shaken when Lazarus was quickened below at the voice of Him Who gives life.

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Чꙋ́до стра́шное и҆ пресла́вное, ка́кѡ създа́тель всѣ́хъ, є҆́же не непозна́ваше, ꙗ҆́кѡ невѣ́дый въпроша́ше, гдѣ̀ лежи́тъ є҆го́же рыда́ете; гдѣ̀ погребе́нъ бы́сть Ла́зарь; є҆го́же пома́лѣ и҆з ме́ртвыхъ жи́ва ва́мъ въскр҃шꙋ а҆́зъ:.
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* The stone which the builders rejected hath become the head of the corner; this is the rock upon which Christ hath established His Church, which He redeemed from the nations.[^25]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*
The stone which the builders rejected hath become the head of the corner; this is the rock upon which Christ hath established His Church, which He redeemed from the nations.[^25]

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Ма́рѳа и҆ Марі́а Гдⷭ҇и рыда́ньми вопїя́хꙋ, се́ є҆го́же люби́лъ є҆сѝ, четверодне́венъ смерди́тъ; а҆́ще бы є҆сѝ бы́лъ здѐ тогда̀, не бы̀ оу҆́меръ Ла́зарь: но ꙗ҆́коже не разлꙋче́нъ бе́зде, є҆го̀ а҆́бїе возгласи́въ въздви́глъ є҆сѝ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A fearful and most glorious wonder: how the Creator of all, Who was not ignorant, inquired as one who knew not: "Where lies he over whom ye weep? Where hath Lazarus been buried?"—whom in a little while I will raise up alive unto you from the dead!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
A fearful and most glorious wonder: how the Creator of all, Who was not ignorant, inquired as one who knew not: "Where lies he over whom ye weep? Where hath Lazarus been buried?"—whom in a little while I will raise up alive unto you from the dead!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Пролїѧ́въ на дрꙋ́гомъ сле́зы смотре́нїѧ ра́ди, показа́лъ є҆сѝ пло́ть ѿ на́съ взе́млемꙋ, сꙋщество̀ не мнѣ́нїемъ Сп҃се соедини́вшꙋ ти сѧ, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ Бг҃ъ, є҆го̀ а҆́бїе възгласи́въ въздви́глъ є҆сѝ:. [кустод: Оу҆вѣ́-]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The stone which they who buried thee had rolled against thee, Jesus commanded to be taken away; and straightway He raised thee, crying aloud unto thee: "Lazarus, arise, come forth unto Me, that Hades may be terrified at thy voice!"

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The stone which they who buried thee had rolled against thee, Jesus commanded to be taken away; and straightway He raised thee, crying aloud unto thee: "Lazarus, arise, come forth unto Me, that Hades may be terrified at thy voice!"

items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Пролїѧ́въ на дрꙋ́гомъ сле́зы смотре́нїѧ ра́ди, показа́лъ є҆сѝ пло́ть ѿ на́съ взе́млемꙋ, сꙋщество̀ не мнѣ́нїемъ Сп҃се соедини́вшꙋ ти сѧ, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ Бг҃ъ, є҆го̀ а҆́бїе възгласи́въ въздви́глъ є҆сѝ:. [кустод: Оу҆вѣ́-]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Martha and Mary cried aloud with weeping, O Lord: "Behold, he that was loved by Thee, four days dead, now stinks; if Thou hadst been here, Lazarus had not died!" But as Thou art present everywhere without separation, Thou didst straightway raise him up by calling unto him.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Martha and Mary cried aloud with weeping, O Lord: "Behold, he that was loved by Thee, four days dead, now stinks; if Thou hadst been here, Lazarus had not died!" But as Thou art present everywhere without separation, Thou didst straightway raise him up by calling unto him.

items.slavonic_text: Пролїѧ́въ на дрꙋ́гомъ сле́зы смотре́нїѧ ра́ди, показа́лъ є҆сѝ пло́ть ѿ на́съ взе́млемꙋ, сꙋщество̀ не мнѣ́нїемъ Сп҃се соедини́вшꙋ ти сѧ, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ Бг҃ъ, є҆го̀ а҆́бїе възгласи́въ въздви́глъ є҆сѝ:. [кустод: Оу҆вѣ́-]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having shed tears over Thy friend for the sake of the dispensation, Thou didst reveal the flesh which Thou tookest from us, having united Thyself unto our essence in reality and not in semblance, O Savior; and as God, the Lover of mankind, Thou didst straightway raise him up by calling unto him.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀ вои́стиннꙋ, нн҃ѣ погибо́хъ вопїя́ше а҆́дъ, си́це возглаша́ше къ сме́рти глаго́ля, се Назаряни́нъ до́лняя подви́же, и҆ оу҆тро́бꙋ мою̀ посѣка́я, без̾ дыха́нїѧ ме́ртва возгласи́въ въздви́же:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* "Woe is me truly! Now am I undone!" cried Hades, and thus he shouted unto Death, saying: "Behold, the Nazarene hath shaken the nether regions, and cutting through my belly, He hath called aloud and raised up the breathless corpse!"

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Гдѣ̀ Евре́йское безꙋ́мїе; гдѣ̀ невѣ́рїе; доко́лѣ чꙋжді́и; доко́лѣ ле́стцы; зри́те оу҆ме́ршаго гла́сомъ и҆сходя́ща, и҆ невѣ́рꙋете Хрⷭ҇то́вꙋ въскр҃сенїю, сы́нове тмы̀ бы́вше:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Where is the Hebrew madness? Where is their unbelief? How long will ye be strangers? How long will ye be deceivers? Behold the dead man coming forth at His voice, yet ye believe not in Christ's resurrection, having become sons of darkness!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро: Стра́нное и҆ стра́шное видѣ́нїе смотре́нїѧ, є҆́же презрѣ́ша нело́жныи Прр҃цы Дв҃о Бг҃овмѣсти́маѧ, оу҆́бѡ заче́ншꙋю, и҆ нетлѣ́ннѡ ро́ждшꙋю Бг҃а, пребыва́ющꙋю же по рождествѣ̀ чⷭ҇тꙋю:.
items.english_text: I know Thee as One of the Trinity, even though Thou hast taken flesh; as One I praise Thee, the incarnate Son Who sprang forth from God without seed, and Who with the Father and the Spirit art glorified as the only Son!

provenance.verbatim_source: I know Thee as One of the Trinity, even though Thou hast taken flesh; as One I praise Thee, the incarnate Son Who sprang forth from God without seed, and Who with the Father and the Spirit art glorified as the only Son!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Припѣ́въ: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Прослези́лся є҆сѝ Гдⷭ҇и на Ла́заремъ, показа́въ ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃къ є҆сѝ, и҆ въздви́глъ є҆сѝ Бл҃ко оу҆ме́ршаго, и҆ показа́лъ є҆сѝ лю́демъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Сн҃ъ є҆сѝ Бж҃їй:.
items.english_text: A strange and dread vision of the dispensation, which the unerring Prophets foresaw, O Virgin who didst contain God: that thou shouldest conceive and in incorruption give birth unto God, yet remain pure after childbirth!

provenance.verbatim_source: A strange and dread vision of the dispensation, which the unerring Prophets foresaw, O Virgin who didst contain God: that thou shouldest conceive and in incorruption give birth unto God, yet remain pure after childbirth!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Бездꙋ́шный оу҆слы́ша повелѣ́нїе твоѐ, грядѝ во́нъ Ла́заре, текі́й воста́ше съ пелена́ми, и҆ скака́ше, бл҃же показа́я держа́вꙋ твою̀:.
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* The sun was lifted up, and the moon stood still in its order; Thou wast lifted up, O Long-suffering One, upon the Tree, and upon it Thou hast established Thy Church.[^26]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos:*
The sun was lifted up, and the moon stood still in its order; Thou wast lifted up, O Long-suffering One, upon the Tree, and upon it Thou hast established Thy Church.[^26]

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Пла́кавъ ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃къ на Ла́заремъ, въставилъ [кустод: є҆сѝ] є҆сѝ є҆го̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ, вопроси́лъ є҆сѝ, гдѣ̀ погребе́нъ четверодне́вный; оу҆вѣря́ѧ Бл҃же въчл҃че́нїе своѐ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst shed tears over Lazarus, O Lord, showing that Thou art man; and Thou didst raise up the dead man, O Master, and didst show unto the peoples that Thou art the Son of God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst shed tears over Lazarus, O Lord, showing that Thou art man; and Thou didst raise up the dead man, O Master, and didst show unto the peoples that Thou art the Son of God!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Стра̑ти знаме́нїа и҆ крⷵта твоегѡ̀ оу҆вѣ́рити хотя̀ Бл҃же, а҆́дово несы́тное чре́во разтерза́въ, възста́вилъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ четверодне́внаго:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The breathless corpse heard Thy command: "Lazarus, come forth!" And he that was bound with grave-clothes arose and ran, leaping forth, showing forth Thy dominion, O Good One!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The breathless corpse heard Thy command: "Lazarus, come forth!" And he that was bound with grave-clothes arose and ran, leaping forth, showing forth Thy dominion, O Good One!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Кто̀ ви́дѣ и҆ кто̀ слы́ша, ꙗ҆́кѡ въста̀ чл҃къ ме́ртвыи смердя́щїй; И҆лїа̀ оу҆́бѡ въздви́же, и҆ Е҆лисе́й, но не ѿ гро́ба, но нижѐ четверодне́вна:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst comfort the tears of Martha and Mary, O Christ; having called Lazarus aloud with sovereign authority, Thou didst raise him up by Thy voice, and he bowed down in worship before Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst comfort the tears of Martha and Mary, O Christ; having called Lazarus aloud with sovereign authority, Thou didst raise him up by Thy voice, and he bowed down in worship before Thee!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ твоѐ Хрⷭ҇тѐ могꙋ́тство, воспѣва́емъ и҆ стра̑ти Хрⷭ҇тѐ. ѡ҆́нѣмъ бо ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ чꙋдодѣ́йствовалъ є҆сѝ, си́ми же смотри́тельнѡ я́тъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃къ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having wept as man over Lazarus, Thou didst raise him up as God; Thou didst inquire: "Where hath the four-day dead man been buried?"—giving assurance, O Good One, of Thine incarnation!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having wept as man over Lazarus, Thou didst raise him up as God; Thou didst inquire: "Where hath the four-day dead man been buried?"—giving assurance, O Good One, of Thine incarnation!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ є҆сѝ и҆ чл҃къ, и҆стинствꙋ́яй вещьмѝ и҆ и҆́мены, прите́клъ є҆сѝ гро́бꙋ пло́тїю Сло́ве, и҆ въздви́глъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ четверодне́бнаго:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Desiring to give assurance of the signs of Thy Passion and of Thy Cross, O Good One, Thou didst tear asunder the insatiable belly of Hades, and didst raise up the four-day dead man as God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Desiring to give assurance of the signs of Thy Passion and of Thy Cross, O Good One, Thou didst tear asunder the insatiable belly of Hades, and didst raise up the four-day dead man as God!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆жасо́шася Бл҃ко Е҆вре́йстїи наро́ди, ꙗ҆́кѡ видѣ́вша въста́вша мр҃тва, и҆з гро́ба Ла́зара, съ гла́сомъ твои́мъ, и҆ пребы́ша неполꙋчи́вша чꙋде́съ твои́хъ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Who hath seen and who hath heard that a dead man already stinking hath arisen? Elijah indeed raised up, and Elisha, but not from a tomb, nor one that was four days dead![^27]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Who hath seen and who hath heard that a dead man already stinking hath arisen? Elijah indeed raised up, and Elisha, but not from a tomb, nor one that was four days dead![^27]

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Безнача́лнѡ въздїя́лъ є҆сѝ ѿ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ своего̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ Є҆ди́нъ сы́й ѿ Трⷵца сп҃се, въ лѣ́то к дв҃ѣ и҆з дѣ́твенныхъ ты произше́лъ є҆сѝ кро́вій, пло́ть взе́мъ преѡбще́ственный:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* We sing of Thy might, O Christ, and we praise Thy Passion, O Christ; for by the one, as tender-hearted, Thou didst work marvels, while by the other, through the dispensation, Thou didst suffer as man!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
We sing of Thy might, O Christ, and we praise Thy Passion, O Christ; for by the one, as tender-hearted, Thou didst work marvels, while by the other, through the dispensation, Thou didst suffer as man!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро: Зача́тїе без̾сѣ́менное Бг҃оцы, и҆ рожество̀ кромѣ̀ стра́сти тлѣ́нїа, Бг҃ъ бо ѡ҆́боя чꙋдодѣ́йствовавый, и҆стощѝ Себѐ да на́мъ съедини́тся:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou art God and man, truly in reality and in name; Thou didst come unto the tomb in the flesh, O Word, and didst raise up the four-day dead man as God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou art God and man, truly in reality and in name; Thou didst come unto the tomb in the flesh, O Word, and didst raise up the four-day dead man as God!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. И҆рмо́съ. Тво́й ми́ръ да́ждь на́мъ Сн҃е Бж҃їй, и҆на́го бо ра́звѣ тебѐ Бг҃а незна́емъ, и҆́мѧ твоѐ и҆менꙋ́емъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ Живы́й и҆ ме́ртвыи є҆сѝ. [кустод: Припѣ́въ]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Hebrew peoples were dismayed, O Master, when they saw the dead Lazarus arise from the tomb at Thy voice, yet they remained without attaining unto faith through Thy marvels!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The Hebrew peoples were dismayed, O Master, when they saw the dead Lazarus arise from the tomb at Thy voice, yet they remained without attaining unto faith through Thy marvels!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening

items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. И҆рмо́съ. Тво́й ми́ръ да́ждь на́мъ Сн҃е Бж҃їй, и҆на́го бо ра́звѣ тебѐ Бг҃а незна́емъ, и҆́мѧ твоѐ и҆менꙋ́емъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ Живы́й и҆ ме́ртвыи є҆сѝ. [кустод: Припѣ́въ]
items.english_text: Without beginning hast Thou shone forth from Thy Father, as One of the Trinity, O Savior; and in the fullness of time, from a Virgin's maidenly blood Thou didst come forth, having taken upon Thyself human flesh, O Thou Who art beyond all communion!

provenance.verbatim_source: Without beginning hast Thou shone forth from Thy Father, as One of the Trinity, O Savior; and in the fullness of time, from a Virgin's maidenly blood Thou didst come forth, having taken upon Thyself human flesh, O Thou Who art beyond all communion!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. И҆рмо́съ. Тво́й ми́ръ да́ждь на́мъ Сн҃е Бж҃їй, и҆на́го бо ра́звѣ тебѐ Бг҃а незна́емъ, и҆́мѧ твоѐ и҆менꙋ́емъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ Живы́й и҆ ме́ртвыи є҆сѝ. [кустод: Припѣ́въ]
items.english_text: Seedless was the conception, O Virgin Mother, and birth without the passion of corruption; for God, having wrought marvels in both, emptied Himself that He might unite Himself unto us!

provenance.verbatim_source: Seedless was the conception, O Virgin Mother, and birth without the passion of corruption; for God, having wrought marvels in both, emptied Himself that He might unite Himself unto us!

items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Grant us Thy peace, O Son of God, for besides Thee we know no other God; we name Thy Name, for Thou art the God of the living and of the dead.[^28]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Непостоянное твоѐ повелѣ́нїе І҆и҃се, не терпя̀ а҆́дъ мно́гихъ прїемый, оу҆боя́ся, и҆ четверодне́вна сꙋ́ща Ла́зара, съ гла́со[мъ] жи́ва а҆ не ме́ртва да́яше:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Being the Life, O Lord, and the true Light, Thou didst call aloud and raise up Lazarus, for being mighty in all things Thou hast shown that Thou art God over the living and the dead!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Being the Life, O Lord, and the true Light, Thou didst call aloud and raise up Lazarus, for being mighty in all things Thou hast shown that Thou art God over the living and the dead!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Пе́рсть совокꙋ́пль дꙋ́хови дре́вле, бре́нїе дꙋхо́мъ жи́зни, ѡ҆дꙋши́вый сло́во своѐ: и҆ нн҃ѣ же сло́вомъ въскр҃силъ є҆сѝ ѿ тлѝ дрꙋ́га и҆ преиспо́днихъ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Hades, which had received many souls, could not endure Thy steadfast command, O Jesus, but was terrified; and at Thy voice it gave up Lazarus, four days dead, alive and not dead!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Hades, which had received many souls, could not endure Thy steadfast command, O Jesus, but was terrified; and at Thy voice it gave up Lazarus, four days dead, alive and not dead!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Ма́нїю твоемꙋ̀ Гдⷭ҇и въпротиви́ся никто́же; є҆гда̀ ко ме́ртваго гла́силъ є҆сѝ Ла́зарю, а҆́бїе въстава́ше бездꙋ́шный, ноꙋ́зы нога́ма хожда́ше:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou Who in ancient times didst unite dust unto spirit, breathing life into the clay by Thy Spirit, O Word: now also by Thy word hast Thou raised up Thy friend from corruption and the nethermost depths!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou Who in ancient times didst unite dust unto spirit, breathing life into the clay by Thy Spirit, O Word: now also by Thy word hast Thou raised up Thy friend from corruption and the nethermost depths!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Ѽ І҆ꙋде́йское безꙋ́мїе! ѡ҆ ѡ҆мраче́нїе враго́въ! кто̀ ви́дѣ ме́ртвеца и҆з гро́ба въста́юща; И҆лїа̀ дре́вле воскр҃си, но не ѿ гро́ба, но нижѐ четверодне́вна.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* None could withstand Thy beckoning nod, O Lord; when Thou didst cry aloud unto the dead Lazarus, the breathless man straightway arose, walking with his feet bound in bands!

items.slavonic_text: Непобѣди́ме долготерпѣли́ве, всѧ̑ на́съ ра́ди творя́й ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ, и҆ терпя́й ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃къ, прича́стники всѧ̑ ны̀ сътворѝ црⷵтвїа твое́гѡ, мл҃твами Ла́заревыми:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O the Jewish madness! O the darkening of the adversaries! Who hath ever seen a dead corpse arise from the tomb? Elijah raised the dead in ancient times, yet not from a tomb, nor one four days dead!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Пренача́лнаѧ, събезна́чалнаѧ, є҆диночⷭ҇тнаѧ Трⷵце, Ѻ҆́ч҃е вседержи́телю и҆ Сн҃е и҆ Дш҃е ст҃ый, Є҆ди́нице ст҃а́я трїѵпоста́внаѧ, сꙋ́щыѧ ѿ А҆да́ма сп҃са́й, вѣ́рнѡ тя̀ воспѣва́ющыя:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O invincible and long-suffering One, Who as God dost all things for our sake, and as man dost endure: make us all partakers of Thy Kingdom, by the prayers of Lazarus!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. И҆рмо́съ. Ѡ҆ве́рглъ мя̀ є҆сѝ, въ глꙋбины̀ се́рдца морска́гѡ, и҆ сп҃слъ мя̀ є҆сѝ сп҃се рабо́ты сме́ртныя, и҆ разрѣши́лъ є҆сѝ оу҆́зы беззако́нїй мои́хъ.
items.english_text: O Trinity transcendent in origin, co-unoriginate, equal in honor: O Father Almighty, Son, and Holy Spirit; O Holy Unity in three Hypostases: save those descended from Adam who faithfully sing Thy praise!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Trinity transcendent in origin, co-unoriginate, equal in honor: O Father Almighty, Son, and Holy Spirit; O Holy Unity in three Hypostases: save those descended from Adam who faithfully sing Thy praise!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Възгласи́лъ мя̀ є҆сѝ Сп҃се и҆з а҆́да преиспо́днягѡ, вопїе́тъ Ла́заръ, к тебѣ̀ раздрꙋши́телю а҆́да, и҆ въздви́глъ мя̀ є҆сѝ ме́ртва повелѣ́нїемъ сѝ:.
items.english_text: Thy most pure womb did He sanctify, O pure Maiden; He Who took flesh from thee, transcendent in divinity, adored in the Trinity: the Word from the Father, and God with the Spirit!

provenance.verbatim_source: Thy most pure womb did He sanctify, O pure Maiden; He Who took flesh from thee, transcendent in divinity, adored in the Trinity: the Word from the Father, and God with the Spirit!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Несы́тное разтерза́въ чре́во а҆́дово, и҆сто́ргнꙋлъ мя̀ є҆сѝ Сп҃се твое́ю вла́стїю, и҆ въздви́глъ мя̀ є҆сѝ ме́ртва повелѣ́нїемъ сѝ:.
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* Thou hast cast me into the depths of the heart of the sea, and hast saved me, O Savior, from the bondage of death, and hast loosed the bonds of mine iniquities.[^29]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆дꙋши́лъ є҆сѝ ты̀ бездыха́нный ѡ҆́бразъ пло́ти моея̀ Сп҃се, стягнꙋ́лъ мя̀ є҆сѝ костьмѝ и҆ жи́лами, и҆ въздви́глъ мя̀ є҆сѝ ме́ртва повелѣ́нїемъ сѝ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst inquire: "Where is he?"—knowing all things; yet Thou didst shed tears, O Savior, as man by nature, and by Thy command Thou didst raise me up who was dead!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*

items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆дѣ́ялъ мя̀ є҆сѝ Сп҃се въ бре́нное тѣ́ло, и҆ въдхнꙋ́лъ мѝ є҆сѝ жи́знь, и҆ видѣ́хъ свѣ́тъ тво́й, и҆ въздви́глъ мя̀ є҆сѝ ме́ртва повелѣ́нїемъ сѝ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* "Thou didst call me aloud, O Savior, from nethermost Hades," Lazarus cries out unto Thee, the Destroyer of Hades, "and by Thy command Thou hast raised me up who was dead!"

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
"Thou didst call me aloud, O Savior, from nethermost Hades," Lazarus cries out unto Thee, the Destroyer of Hades, "and by Thy command Thou hast raised me up who was dead!"

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Поне́слъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, смѣше́нїе всецѣ́ло, сохрани́лъ же є҆сѝ чⷭ҇тꙋю непоро́чнꙋю Мт҃рь, и҆з нея́же проше́лъ є҆сѝ воплоти́вся, є҆ди́нъ сы́й Трⷵца:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having torn asunder the insatiable belly of Hades, Thou hast snatched me away, O Savior, by Thy sovereign power, and by Thy command Thou hast raised me up who was dead!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Having torn asunder the insatiable belly of Hades, Thou hast snatched me away, O Savior, by Thy sovereign power, and by Thy command Thou hast raised me up who was dead!

items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Трⷵце ст҃а́я прославля́ю твоѐ бл҃гоꙋтро́бїе, и҆ съ А҆́гг҃лы пою̀ трⷵтꙋ́ю пѣ́нь, поми́лꙋй дꙋ́ша на́съ въспѣва́ющихъ тя̀:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast given soul unto the breathless form of my flesh, O Savior; Thou hast knit me together with bones and sinews,[^30] and by Thy command Thou hast raised me up who was dead!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou hast given soul unto the breathless form of my flesh, O Savior; Thou hast knit me together with bones and sinews,[^30] and by Thy command Thou hast raised me up who was dead!

items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро: Въ пречⷭ҇тꙋю твою̀ оу҆́тробꙋ вни́де Сло́во, съблюде́ же па́ки по рождествѣ̀ сїю̀ чⷭ҇тꙋю, Бг҃ома́ти, чꙋ́до въи́стиннꙋ пресла́вное:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast clothed me, O Savior, in an earthly body, and breathed life into me, and I beheld Thy light; and by Thy command Thou hast raised me up who was dead!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou hast clothed me, O Savior, in an earthly body, and breathed life into me, and I beheld Thy light; and by Thy command Thou hast raised me up who was dead!

items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. И҆рмо́съ. Сꙋ́щымъ въ пещѝ ѻ҆трокѡ́мъ твои̑мъ Сп҃се, неприкосну́ся нижѐ вредѝ и҆̀хъ ѻ҆́гнь, тогда̀ трі́е ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нѣми оу҆сты̀ поя́хꙋ, и҆ благословля́хꙋ гля́ще: бл҃венъ Бг҃ъ ѻ҆тє́цъ наши́хъ. [кустод: На ме́ртвы]
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst bear our compound nature entirely, O Savior, yet Thou didst preserve pure and blameless the Mother from whom Thou didst come forth incarnate, being One of the Trinity!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst bear our compound nature entirely, O Savior, yet Thou didst preserve pure and blameless the Mother from whom Thou didst come forth incarnate, being One of the Trinity!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. И҆рмо́съ. Сꙋ́щымъ въ пещѝ ѻ҆трокѡ́мъ твои̑мъ Сп҃се, неприкосну́ся нижѐ вредѝ и҆̀хъ ѻ҆́гнь, тогда̀ трі́е ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нѣми оу҆сты̀ поя́хꙋ, и҆ благословля́хꙋ гля́ще: бл҃венъ Бг҃ъ ѻ҆тє́цъ наши́хъ. [кустод: На ме́ртвы]
items.english_text: O Holy Trinity, I glorify Thy compassion, and with the Angels I sing the thrice-holy hymn: have mercy on the souls of us who praise Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Holy Trinity, I glorify Thy compassion, and with the Angels I sing the thrice-holy hymn: have mercy on the souls of us who praise Thee!

items.english_text: Into thy most pure womb entered the Word, and after childbirth He preserved it pure again, O Mother of God: a marvel truly most glorious!

items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* Unto Thy youths in the furnace, O Savior, the fire neither touched nor harmed them; then the three, as with one mouth, sang and blessed, saying: "Blessed is the God of our fathers!"[^31]

items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Над ме́ртвцем прослези́лся є҆сѝ Сп҃се чл҃колюбче, да пока́жеши всѣ̑мъ лю́демъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ сы́й, на́съ дѣ́ля чл҃къ ꙗ҆ви́лся є҆сѝ, и҆ во́лею прослези́лся є҆сѝ, ѡ҆́бразы на́мъ предлага́я срⷣчныѧ любве́:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Over the dead man Thou didst shed tears, O Savior, Lover of mankind, that Thou mightest show unto all peoples that being God, Thou didst appear as man for our sake; and willingly didst Thou shed tears, setting before us patterns of heartfelt love!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Over the dead man Thou didst shed tears, O Savior, Lover of mankind, that Thou mightest show unto all peoples that being God, Thou didst appear as man for our sake; and willingly didst Thou shed tears, setting before us patterns of heartfelt love!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Четверодне́вный Ла́заръ Сп҃се, ꙗ҆́кѡ оу҆слы́ша ни́зꙋ гла́съ тво́й, въста́въ вопѣ́ тя, и҆ ра́дꙋяся си́це вопїя́ше, ты̀ Бг҃ъ и҆ Созда́тель мо́й, тебѐ покланя́юся и҆ хвалю̀ въскри́сившаго мя̀:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When Lazarus, four days dead, heard Thy voice below, O Savior, he arose and praised Thee, and rejoicing he cried aloud: "Thou art my God and my Creator; I worship Thee and glorify Him Who raised me up!"

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
When Lazarus, four days dead, heard Thy voice below, O Savior, he arose and praised Thee, and rejoicing he cried aloud: "Thou art my God and my Creator; I worship Thee and glorify Him Who raised me up!"

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: А҆́ще и҆ оу҆́зами ѡ҆бложе́нъ є҆́смъ, Ла́заръ ни́зꙋ вопїя́ше Свободи́телю, но ника́коже въ чре́вѣ пребꙋ́дꙋ а҆́дово, а҆́ще то́кмѡ возове́ши мя̀: Ла́заре грядѝ во́нъ, ты́ бо мо́й свѣ́тъ є҆сѝ и҆ живо́тъ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* "Even though I am encompassed with grave-bands," Lazarus cried from below unto the Deliverer, "yet in no wise shall I remain in the belly of Hades, if only Thou callest aloud unto me: 'Lazarus, come forth!'—for Thou art my Light and Life!"

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
"Even though I am encompassed with grave-bands," Lazarus cried from below unto the Deliverer, "yet in no wise shall I remain in the belly of Hades, if only Thou callest aloud unto me: 'Lazarus, come forth!'—for Thou art my Light and Life!"

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Молю́ тя Ла́заре, а҆́дъ речѐ, въста́ни и҆зы́йди ѿ закле́пѡвъ мои́хъ ско́рѡ, и҆́нди оу҆́бѡ, добро̀ бо ми є҆ди́наго рыда́ти го́рцѣ ше́млема, не́жели всѣ́хъ, и҆́хже дре́вле а҆́лчѧ поглоти́хъ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* "I implore thee, Lazarus," said Hades, "arise and go forth quickly from my bars; depart indeed, for it is better for me to lament bitterly over one man being snatched away, than over all whom I greedily swallowed in ancient times!"[^32]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
"I implore thee, Lazarus," said Hades, "arise and go forth quickly from my bars; depart indeed, for it is better for me to lament bitterly over one man being snatched away, than over all whom I greedily swallowed in ancient times!"[^32]

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Что̀ косни́ши Ла́заре, грядѝ во́нъ, зове́тъ стоя̀ дрꙋ́гъ тво́й; и҆зы́йди оу҆́бѡ, да и҆ а҆́зъ ѡ҆сла́бꙋ прїиму̀, ѡ҆не́лѣ бо тебѐ снѣ́дохъ, на блева́нїе пи́ща оу҆стро́и ми ся:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* "Why dost thou tarry, Lazarus? Come forth! Thy Friend stands calling thee; depart therefore, that I also may find relief; for since I devoured thee, my food hath become unto me an emetic!"

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
"Why dost thou tarry, Lazarus? Come forth! Thy Friend stands calling thee; depart therefore, that I also may find relief; for since I devoured thee, my food hath become unto me an emetic!"

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Что̀ не воста́неши Ла́заре ско́рѡ, возбїѝ и҆з до́лꙋ а҆д плаче́внѣ; что̀ не а҆́бїе въскр҃съ тече́ши ѿсю́дꙋ; да не и҆ дрꙋ́ги ми плѣни́тъ Хрⷭ҇то́съ въскр҃си́въ тебѐ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* "Why dost thou not arise quickly, Lazarus?" cried Hades lamentably from below; "Why dost thou not straightway arise and hasten hence? Lest Christ, having raised thee, plunder my other captives as well!"

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Оу҆диви́ся є҆сѝ Бл҃ко Хрⷭ҇тѐ, чꙋ́дная тогда̀ съдѣ́лавъ мно́гая. свѣ́тъ бо слѣпы̑мъ, глꙋхи̑мъ же оу҆́ши ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ сло́во[мъ], и҆ дрꙋ́га Ла́зара и҆з ме́ртвыхъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ възгласи́въ въздви́глъ є҆сѝ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou wast marvelous, O Master Christ, having wrought many wonders at that time; for Thou didst open the eyes of the blind and the ears of the deaf by Thy word, and Thy friend Lazarus from among the dead Thou didst call aloud and raise up as God!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou wast marvelous, O Master Christ, having wrought many wonders at that time; for Thou didst open the eyes of the blind and the ears of the deaf by Thy word, and Thy friend Lazarus from among the dead Thou didst call aloud and raise up as God!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃ородиченъ. Ꙗ҆́кѡ Є҆ди́наго ѿ Трⷵца тебѐ Хрⷭ҇те сла́вимъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ Дв҃ы вопло́щься, кро́мѣ преложе́нїѧ чл҃чествѣ всѧ̑ съдержа́лъ є҆сѝ, не ѿстꙋ́пль є҆стества̀ Ѻ҆́ч҃ка І҆и҃се, а҆́ще и҆ примѣни́лся є҆сѝ на́мъ:.
items.english_text: Let us sing a hymn unto the Trinity, glorifying the unoriginate Father, the Son, and the simple Spirit: one single Essence which we praise in Trinity: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O Trinity!

provenance.verbatim_source: Let us sing a hymn unto the Trinity, glorifying the unoriginate Father, the Son, and the simple Spirit: one single Essence which we praise in Trinity: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O Trinity!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Творе́цъ и҆ съдержи́тель всѣ́хъ, за Марї́е въ Виѳа́нїю прїи́де, въздви́гнꙋти Ла́зара:.
items.english_text: As One of the Trinity we praise Thee, O Christ, for having been incarnate of the Virgin without change, Thou didst contain all things in Thine humanity, without departing from the Father's essence, O Jesus, even though Thou hast been united unto us!

provenance.verbatim_source: As One of the Trinity we praise Thee, O Christ, for having been incarnate of the Virgin without change, Thou didst contain all things in Thine humanity, without departing from the Father's essence, O Jesus, even though Thou hast been united unto us!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Четверодне́вный смердя̀, и҆ поко́ими ѡ҆бя́занъ, и҆змѣне́нїя дыха́нїемъ бездꙋ́шный, възгласи́вшꙋ ти Гдⷭ҇и:.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* All ye heavens, and ye waters that are above the heavens: bless, sing, and exalt the Lord unto ages of ages![^33]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 8. Heirmos:*
All ye heavens, and ye waters that are above the heavens: bless, sing, and exalt the Lord unto ages of ages![^33]

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: І҆оуде́йстїи лю́дїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ видѣ́ша оу҆ме́ршаго, твои́мъ гла́сомъ въста́вша Хрⷭ҇тѐ, рапыха́хꙋся:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Creator and Sustainer of all came unto Bethany for Mary's sake, to raise up Lazarus!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The Creator and Sustainer of all came unto Bethany for Mary's sake, to raise up Lazarus!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆мраче́нїи ѡ҆ свѣ́тѣ І҆оуде́е, что̀ невѣ́рꙋете Ла́заревꙋ воста́нїю, Бж҃їю начина́нїю:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The four-day dead, stinking, and bound with burial bands, was changed by the breath of life from breathlessness, when Thou didst call aloud, O Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The four-day dead, stinking, and bound with burial bands, was changed by the breath of life from breathlessness, when Thou didst call aloud, O Lord!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Да ра́дꙋется Сїѡ́нъ, и҆ да пое́тъ жизнода́вца, въскри́сившаго сло́вомъ ѿ гро́ба Ла́зара:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When the Jewish people beheld the dead man arisen at Thy voice, O Christ, they were filled with rage!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
When the Jewish people beheld the dead man arisen at Thy voice, O Christ, they were filled with rage!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Во́и нбⷵнїи, и҆ ро́дъ земны́хъ возопѣ́ша тя̀, є҆гда̀ сп҃се мо́й Ла́зара въздви́глъ є҆сѝ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O ye Jews darkened concerning the Light, why do ye not believe in the resurrection of Lazarus, which is the work of God?

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
O ye Jews darkened concerning the Light, why do ye not believe in the resurrection of Lazarus, which is the work of God?

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Съ Ѻ҆ц҃емъ и҆ Сн҃омъ Дх҃а славосло́вли, и҆ пою̀ немо́лчнѡ въззыва́ю, Трⷵто́чныи сла́ва тебѣ̀:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Let Zion rejoice, and let it sing unto the Giver of life, Who by His word hath raised up Lazarus from the tomb!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Let Zion rejoice, and let it sing unto the Giver of life, Who by His word hath raised up Lazarus from the tomb!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Тебѐ бл҃гли и҆ покланя́нїя, ро́жшомꙋся и҆з Дв҃ы неразлꙋ́чїяся Прⷵто́ла ст҃ыя сла́вы твоеѧ̀:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The heavenly hosts and the race of mortals sang Thy praise, my Savior, when Thou didst raise up Lazarus!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The heavenly hosts and the race of mortals sang Thy praise, my Savior, when Thou didst raise up Lazarus!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. И҆рмо́съ. Сътворѝ держа́вꙋ мы́шцею свое́ю: низложѝ си́лныя съ престо́лъ, и҆ вознесѐ смире́нныя Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ, въ ни́хже посѣтѝ на́съ восто́къ съвы́ше, и҆ направилъ ны є҆́сть на пꙋ́ть ми́рный. [кустод: Да пое́тъ]
items.english_text: With the Father and the Son I glorify the Spirit, and singing I ceaselessly cry aloud: O Thrice-radiant Trinity, glory to Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: With the Father and the Son I glorify the Spirit, and singing I ceaselessly cry aloud: O Thrice-radiant Trinity, glory to Thee!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. И҆рмо́съ. Сътворѝ держа́вꙋ мы́шцею свое́ю: низложѝ си́лныя съ престо́лъ, и҆ вознесѐ смире́нныя Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ, въ ни́хже посѣтѝ на́съ восто́къ съвы́ше, и҆ направилъ ны є҆́сть на пꙋ́ть ми́рный. [кустод: Да пое́тъ]
items.english_text: We bless and worship Thee Who wast born of the Virgin, without separating from the Throne of Thy holy glory!

provenance.verbatim_source: We bless and worship Thee Who wast born of the Virgin, without separating from the Throne of Thy holy glory!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. И҆рмо́съ. Сътворѝ держа́вꙋ мы́шцею свое́ю: низложѝ си́лныя съ престо́лъ, и҆ вознесѐ смире́нныя Бг҃ъ І҆и҃левъ, въ ни́хже посѣтѝ на́съ восто́къ съвы́ше, и҆ направилъ ны є҆́сть на пꙋ́ть ми́рный. [кустод: Да пое́тъ]
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* He hath shown strength with His arm; He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted the humble, the God of Israel; wherein the Dayspring from on high hath visited us, and guided our feet into the way of peace.[^34]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 9. Heirmos:*
He hath shown strength with His arm; He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted the humble, the God of Israel; wherein the Dayspring from on high hath visited us, and guided our feet into the way of peace.[^34]

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Да пое́тъ чꙋ́до вида́нїѧ Сїѡ́нъ, въ не́й бо прослези́ся созда́тель, зако́номъ є҆стества̀ пло́ти Ла́зара въскреша́я, и҆ Ма́рѳины сле́зы про́че и҆ пла́чъ Марї́инъ въ ра́дость прелага́я ме́ртвеца въздви́глъ є҆́сть:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Let Zion sing of the marvel of the vision; for in her the Creator wept, according to the law of the nature of the flesh when raising Lazarus; and turning Martha's tears and Mary's weeping into joy, He raised up the dead man!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Let Zion sing of the marvel of the vision; for in her the Creator wept, according to the law of the nature of the flesh when raising Lazarus; and turning Martha's tears and Mary's weeping into joy, He raised up the dead man!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆вѣря́я Сло́ве въскр҃се́нїе своѐ, призва́лъ є҆сѝ Ла́зара и҆з гро́ба, и҆ въздви́глъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ, да пока́жеши лю́де[мъ] ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ же и҆ чл҃къ вкꙋ́пѣ въи́стиннѣ сꙋ́ща, и҆ въздви́гша хра́мъ тѣ́лесе твое́гѡ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Giving assurance of Thy resurrection, O Word, Thou didst call Lazarus from the tomb, and didst raise him up as God, that Thou mightest show unto the peoples that Thou art truly both God and man in one, and that Thou hast raised up the temple of Thy Body!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Giving assurance of Thy resurrection, O Word, Thou didst call Lazarus from the tomb, and didst raise him up as God, that Thou mightest show unto the peoples that Thou art truly both God and man in one, and that Thou hast raised up the temple of Thy Body!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Сътря́слъ є҆сѝ вра́та и҆ верѣѧ̑ желѣ̑зныѧ, оу҆страши́лъ є҆сѝ а҆́дъ гла́сомъ свои́мъ, и҆ оу҆жасе́ся съ ни́мъ и҆ сме́рть а҆́бїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ видѣ́ша Ла́заря сп҃се є҆ди́на оу҆ ни́хъ оу҆́жника, ѡ҆дꙋшевле́нна гла́сомъ и҆ въскре́сша:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst shake the gates and iron bars, Thou didst terrify Hades with Thy voice, and Death likewise was dismayed with him, when they beheld Lazarus, their single captive, given soul by Thy voice and risen, O Savior!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Thou didst shake the gates and iron bars, Thou didst terrify Hades with Thy voice, and Death likewise was dismayed with him, when they beheld Lazarus, their single captive, given soul by Thy voice and risen, O Savior!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆жасо́шася всѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ видѣ́ша тя̀ Сп҃се слезя́ща Ла́зара оу҆ме́рша, и҆ гла́са на подви́гъ ка́кѡ є҆го̀ люби́ше, а҆́бїе оу҆́бѡ возгласи́л є҆сѝ є҆го̀, и҆ въста́въ бездꙋ́шный ѿложѝ тлѣ́нїе, повелѣ́нїемъ твои́мъ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* All were dismayed when they saw Thee shedding tears, O Savior, over the dead Lazarus, and moved unto utterance of how Thou didst love him; straightway therefore Thou didst call him aloud, and the breathless man arose, casting off corruption at Thy command!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
All were dismayed when they saw Thee shedding tears, O Savior, over the dead Lazarus, and moved unto utterance of how Thou didst love him; straightway therefore Thou didst call him aloud, and the breathless man arose, casting off corruption at Thy command!

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Подвиго́шася две́ри, съкрꙋши́шася верѣѧ̑, раздрѣши́шася оу҆́зы ме́ртвагѡ, гла́сомъ си́лы Хрⷭ҇то́вы, и҆ а҆́дъ го́ркѡ въздъıха́ше рыда́я, и҆ свои̑мъ вопїя́ше, оу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀: кі́й, и҆ ѿкꙋ́дꙋ гла́съ ѡ҆живля́яй ме́ртвыя:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The doors were shaken, the bars were shattered, the bonds of the dead man were loosed at the voice of Christ's power; and Hades groaned bitterly, weeping and crying aloud unto his minions: "Woe is me! What and whence is this voice that gives life unto the dead?"

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
The doors were shaken, the bars were shattered, the bonds of the dead man were loosed at the voice of Christ's power; and Hades groaned bitterly, weeping and crying aloud unto his minions: "Woe is me! What and whence is this voice that gives life unto the dead?"

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Въста́ни ѿтꙋ́дꙋ послꙋ́шай гла́са, дрꙋ́гъ бо тво́й во́нъ приглаша́ет тя̀, се́й є҆́ст пре́же въскри́нвыи ме́ртвыя. И҆лїа̀ воздви́же ме́ртва и҆ Е҆лисе́й кꙋ́пнѡ: но сі́и бѣ̀ ѡ҆́нѣми и҆ гла́ни дѣ́йствова́ли:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* "Arise thence, give ear unto the voice! For thy Friend calls thee forth; He is the One Who previously raised the dead. Elijah raised the dead, and Elisha together with him; but they acted through prayers and supplications!"

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
"Arise thence, give ear unto the voice! For thy Friend calls thee forth; He is the One Who previously raised the dead. Elijah raised the dead, and Elisha together with him; but they acted through prayers and supplications!"

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ѿкꙋ́дꙋ мѝ се́й повелѣва́яй ме́ртвымъ; повелѣ́нїемъ бо речѐ, Ла́заре грядѝ во́нъ, и҆ вся̀ моя̀ крѣ́пость смꙋща́етъ ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ, ѡ҆ставля́ет мя̀ Ла́заръ, и҆ про́стъ и҆схо́дитъ и҆з гро́ба, не въмѣща́етъ мѝ чре́во Назаре́совѣхъ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* "And whence comes this Man unto me Who commands the dead? For by a command He said: 'Lazarus, come forth!'—and all my strength is confounded as by God; Lazarus leaves me, and comes forth loosed from the tomb; the belly of the Nazarene's foes cannot hold him!"

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
"And whence comes this Man unto me Who commands the dead? For by a command He said: 'Lazarus, come forth!'—and all my strength is confounded as by God; Lazarus leaves me, and comes forth loosed from the tomb; the belly of the Nazarene's foes cannot hold him!"

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: Пое́мъ ти Сло́ве непобѣди́мꙋю крѣ́пость, костьмѝ бо и҆ жи́лами оу҆ме́рша въздви́глъ є҆сѝ сло́вомъ свои̑мъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ всѣ́хъ созда́тель, и҆ сего̀ въскри́силъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се ѿ преиспо́днихъ, ꙗ҆́коже вдовы́я сы́на ѻ҆тца̀ на ѻ҆дрѣ̀:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* We sing unto Thee, O Word, Thine invincible power; for with bones and sinews Thou didst raise up the dead man by Thy word, as Creator of all; and Thou didst raise him up, O Savior, from the nethermost depths, even as Thou didst raise the widow's son from the bier before his mother![^35]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
We sing unto Thee, O Word, Thine invincible power; for with bones and sinews Thou didst raise up the dead man by Thy word, as Creator of all; and Thou didst raise him up, O Savior, from the nethermost depths, even as Thou didst raise the widow's son from the bier before his mother![^35]

items.office: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.season_or_tone: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK
items.day_or_date: Lazarus Saturday: Vespers on Friday Evening
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро: Вся̀ сътво́ривый въ премꙋ́дрости І҆и҃се, и҆ въ всего́ мя ѡ҆болкі́йся и҆з Дв҃ы, и҆ ве́сь пребыва́яй при́снѡ въ нѣ́драхъ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀, ст҃ый Дх҃ъ тво́й Хрⷭ҇тѐ, на ста́до твоѐ низпосла́въ ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ, ѡ҆брѣ́ки на́съ:.
items.english_text: All-Holy Trinity, unoriginate Father and God, co-unoriginate Son and Divine Word, Good Comforter and Holy Spirit of God: O single and thrice-radiant Light, essential Essence, One God and Lord: have mercy on the world!

provenance.verbatim_source: All-Holy Trinity, unoriginate Father and God, co-unoriginate Son and Divine Word, Good Comforter and Holy Spirit of God: O single and thrice-radiant Light, essential Essence, One God and Lord: have mercy on the world!

items.slavonic_text: НА ОУ҆́ТРЕНИ. На Бг҃ъ Гдⷭ҇ь: Тропа́рь, Гла́съ, а҃. г҃. Ѡ́бщее въскрⷵсе́нїе пре́жде своеѧ̀ стра́сти оу҆вѣря́я, и҆з ме́ртвыхъ въздви́глъ є҆сѝ Ла́заря Хе҃ Бж҃е. Тѣ́мже и҆ мы̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆́троцы побѣ́ды знаме́нїѧ нося́ще, тебѣ̀ Побѣди́телю сме́рти вопїе́мъ: Ѡ҆са́нна въ вы́шнихъ, бл҃гослове́нъ грѧды́й въ и҆́мя Гдⷭ҇не. Та́же Сті́холо: Речѐ Гдⷭ҇ь Гдⷭ҇ви моемꙋ̀. [кустод: Полѵка:]
items.english_text: O Jesus Who hast made all things in wisdom, and didst clothe Thyself completely with me from the Virgin, yet ever abidest wholly in the bosom of the Father: having sent down Thy Holy Spirit upon Thy flock as God, visit and preserve us!

items.english_text: After *Blessed is our God:* and the Creed (*I believe in one God:*), and after the first Trisagion (*Our Father:*), we chant the Troparion: *By raising Lazarus from the dead...* (*Ѡ́бщее въскресе́нїе...*). After the final Trisagion and *Our Father:*, the Kontakion: *Christ the Joy of all...* (*Всѣ́хъ ра́дость Хрїсто́съ...*). *Lord, have mercy* (12 times), and the Dismissal. But the prayer *Remember, O Lord...* (*Помянѝ Го́споди...*) we do not say.[^36]

After the final Trisagion and *Our Father:*, the Kontakion: *Christ the Joy of all...* (*Всѣ́хъ ра́дость Хрїсто́съ...*). *Lord, have mercy* (12 times), and the Dismissal. items.english_text: *Troparion, Tone 1:* By raising Lazarus from the dead before Thy Passion, Thou didst confirm the universal resurrection, O Christ God! Therefore, like the children, we also carry the symbols of victory and cry aloud unto Thee, the Vanquisher of Death: Hosanna in the highest! Blessed is He Who comes in the Name of the Lord![^37]

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Та́же Сті́холовимъ Непоро́чна, И҆ пое́мъ въскрⷵна: Бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ Гдⷭ҇и. А҆́гг҃лскїй собо́ръ: и҆ про́чая ꙗ҆́коже ѡ҆бы́чай є҆́сть въ Нд҃лю. И҆ по исполне́нїи си́хъ, Сѣда́ленъ. Гла́съ, є҃. Подо́бенъ: Събезнача́лное сло́во: И҆сто́чникъ премꙋ́дрости и҆ предвѣ́дѣнїѧ, въ Виѳа́нїи прише́дъ съ Ма́рѳою сꙋ́щихъ вопроша́лъ є҆сѝ, гдѣ̀ положи́сте ре́къ дрꙋ́га Ла́зара; є҆го́же ра́ди прослези́въся бл҃гоꙋтро́бне, четверодне́вна ме́ртва въскр҃си́лъ є҆сѝ гла́сомъ свои́мъ чл҃колюбче и҆ ще́дрый, ꙗ҆́кѡ жизнода́вецъ и҆ Гдⷭ҇ь:. Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: то́же.
items.english_text: Having pitied the tears of Martha and Mary, Thou didst command the stone to be rolled away from the tomb, O Christ God; and calling aloud, Thou didst raise up the dead man, confirming the resurrection of the world in Thyself, O Giver of life: Glory to Thy power, O Savior; glory to Thine authority; glory unto Him Who by His word established all things!

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 5, Podoben: "Co-beginning with the Father" (Събезнача́лное сло́во):*[^41] O Fountain of wisdom and foreknowledge, having arrived in Bethany, Thou didst inquire of those with Martha, saying: "Where have ye laid My friend Lazarus?"—for whose sake, having shed tears in Thy tender compassion, Thou didst raise up the four-day dead man by Thy voice, O Lover of mankind and Merciful One, as Giver of life and Lord!

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Гла́съ, и҆́. Подо́бенъ: Премꙋ́дрости: Предвѣ́дый вся́ческая ꙗ҆́кѡ творе́цъ, въ Виѳа́нїи предре́клъ є҆сѝ Оу҆ч҃никомъ свои́мъ, дрꙋ́гъ на́шъ Ла́зарь оу҆спѐ дне́сь: и҆ вѣ́дый въпроси́лъ є҆сѝ ре́къ, гдѐ положи́сте и҆; и҆ ѻ҆тцꙋ̀ помоли́лся є҆сѝ прослези́въся ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃къ: Тѣ́мже и҆ възгласи́въ, є҆го́же люби́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆з а҆́да въздви́глъ є҆сѝ Гдⷭ҇и четверодне́бнаго Ла́зара: Сегѡ̀ ра́ди вѣ́стїемъ тѝ, прїимѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, дерза́ющихъ приноси́ти хвале́нїе, и҆ сподо́би всѣ́хъ сла́вѣ твое́й.
items.english_text: Thy friend Lazarus, wrapped in grave-bands, O Lord, Thou didst snatch away from dark Hades by Thy word, shattering the keys and the kingdoms of all-powerful Death!

items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4, Podoben: "Joseph marveled" (Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ):*[^46] The sisters of Lazarus stood together before Christ, and weeping bitterly and lamenting for him, they said unto Him: "Lazarus is dead!" But He, as God not being ignorant of his burial, inquired as man: "Where have ye laid him?" And approaching the tomb, He called aloud the four-day Lazarus; and they lovingly bowed down in worship before Him Who called him forth!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 4, Podoben: "Joseph marveled" (Оу҆диви́ся І҆ѡ́сифъ):*[^46]
The sisters of Lazarus stood together before Christ, and weeping bitterly and lamenting for him, they said unto Him: "Lazarus is dead!" And approaching the tomb, He called aloud the four-day Lazarus; and they lovingly bowed down in worship before Him Who called him forth!

items.slavonic_text: И҆ны́й И҆рмо́съ. Ты моѧ̀ крѣ́пость Гдⷭ҇и: Ты ꙗ҆́кѡ па́стырь въсхити́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ чл҃ка, разтлѣ́вша оу҆жѐ четверодне́вна вседѣ́телю, ѿ во́лка лю́таго вои́стиннꙋ и҆ всеꙗ́дца, ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́ленъ же и҆ Гдⷭ҇ь, си̑мъ проявля́ѧ всемї́рнꙋю сла́вꙋ, твоегѡ̀ тридне́внагѡ възста́нїа:. [кустод: Тебѣ̀]
items.english_text: Foreknowing all things as Creator, in Bethany Thou didst foretell unto Thy Disciples: "Our friend Lazarus hath fallen asleep today!" And knowing, Thou didst inquire, saying: "Where have ye laid him?" And Thou didst pray unto the Father, having wept as man: therefore, having called aloud him whom Thou lovedst, Thou didst raise up from Hades the four-day Lazarus, O Lord! Therefore with faith we cry unto Thee: Receive, O Christ God, those who dare to offer praise, and make all worthy of Thy glory!

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро: Ты вѣ́рнымъ похва́ла є҆сѝ безневѣ́стная, ты предста́телница, ты и҆ прибѣ́жище Хрⷭ҇тїа́нѡмъ, стѣна̀ и҆ приста́нище: къ сн҃ꙋ бо твое́мꙋ мл҃енїѧ прино́сиши всенепоро́чная, и҆ сп҃са́еши ѿ бѣ́дъ вѣ́рою и҆ любо́вїю Бцⷣꙋ чтꙋ́щыѧ тя̀:.
items.english_text: The abysses fear Thee as the Fountain, O Lord; the springs and the seas serve Thee; the bars of Hades tremble before Thee, O Christ, and the keys are broken by Thy dominion, when Lazarus was raised from the dead by Thy voice, O Almighty Savior and Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: The abysses fear Thee as the Fountain, O Lord; the springs and the seas serve Thee; the bars of Hades tremble before Thee, O Christ, and the keys are broken by Thy dominion, when Lazarus was raised from the dead by Thy voice, O Almighty Savior and Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. И҆рмо́съ. Вскꙋ́ю мя̀ ѿри́нꙋлъ є҆сѝ: Предста́въ Ла́заревꙋ гро́бꙋ чл҃колюбче, сего́ призва́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ жи́знь пода́лъ є҆сѝ: ꙗ҆́кѡ жи́знь сы́й безсме́ртная чл҃кѡмъ всѣ̑мъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ бꙋ́дꙋщее проѡбразꙋ́ѧ та́кѡ въскр҃се́нїе:.
items.english_text: Thou art the boast of the faithful, O Unwedded One; thou art the protectress, thou art the haven and the wall of Christians: for unto thy Son thou dost offer supplications, O all-blameless one, and dost deliver from perils those who with faith and love honor thee as Mother of God!

items.slavonic_text: Свя́занъ нога́ма Ла́заръ хожда́ше, чꙋ́до въ чꙋдесѣ́хъ, и҆́бо колі́и ꙗ҆ви́ся въздержа́нїющаго оу҆крѣпля́яй и҆̀ Хе҃: є҆го́же сло́вꙋ вся̑ раболѣ́пнѡ слꙋ́жатъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ꙋ и҆ Вл҃цѣ рабо́тающа:.
items.english_text: *Katavasia:* *Thou art my strength, O Lord, Thou art my power, Thou art my God, Thou art my rejoicing; Who didst not leave the bosom of the Father, yet didst visit our poverty: therefore with the Prophet Habakkuk I cry unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind!*

items.slavonic_text: Ме́ртва смердя́ща Ла́зара въздви́гнувый Хе҃ четверодне́вна, въздви́гни мя̀ оу҆ме́ршаго нн҃ѣ грѣхмѝ мои́ми, и҆ положе́на въ гро́бѣ и҆ сѣ́ни сме́ртной, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ мл҃рдъ и҆зба́ви и҆ сп҃си́ мя:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* *Ode 5. Heirmos: "Why hast Thou cast me off" (Вскꙋ́ю мя̀ ѿри́нꙋлъ є҆сѝ):*[^50] Standing at Lazarus's tomb, O Lover of mankind, Thou didst summon him and grant him life; for being immortal Life unto all mortals, as God Thou didst thus prefigure the future resurrection!

items.slavonic_text: И҆рмо́съ: то́йже. Ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ сла́вꙋ принося̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ не Бг҃опроти́вный бы́лъ є҆сѝ мл҃ся, предстоя́щїи оу҆вѣря́я наро́дъ долготерпѣли́ве, и҆ бл҃гренїе свое́мꙋ Ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ принося̀, повелѣ́нїемъ въздвиза́еши Ла́зара:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Bound hand and foot, Lazarus walked—a wonder among wonders! For Christ was shown strengthening him who was restrained, unto Whose word all things serve as bondslaves, doing homage unto Him as God and Master!

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Мл҃твами Ла́зара, Ма́рѳы же и҆ Марї́и, на́съ сподо́би зри́телей бы́ти, Крⷵта̀, и҆ стра̑тїй твои́хъ Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ свѣтоно́сницы дне́мъ и҆ цр҃ицы въскр҃се́нїя твое́го чл҃колю́бче:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* *Heirmos: The same.* Offering glory unto the Father, praying that Thou mightest not be thought an adversary of God, giving assurance unto the standing crowd, O Long-suffering One, and rendering thanksgiving unto Thy Father, by a command Thou dost raise up Lazarus!

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃о: Мт҃рнее дерзнове́нїе, къ сн҃ꙋ твое́мꙋ и҆мꙋ́щи прⷵчтаѧ, сродна́го промышле́нїѧ ѡ҆ на́съ не пре́зри мо́лимъся, ꙗ҆́кѡ тебѐ є҆ди́нꙋ Хрⷭ҇тїя́не къ Вл҃цѣ оу҆милостивле́нїе бл҃гопрїя́тное предлага́емъ:.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O voice promised by God! O Divine power of Thy dominion, O Savior! Whereby Thou didst shatter the gates of Hades and all-devouring Death; snatch me also away from my passions, as Thou didst formerly snatch away Thy four-day friend Lazarus!

items.slavonic_text: Ѿсе́лѣ начина́ются Четверопѣ́снцы. И҆рмо́сы на два̀. и҆ Тропа́рїѧ на четы́ри. Кѵ́ръ Ко́змы. Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. И҆рмо́съ. І҆ѡ́нꙋ въ ки́тѣ Гдⷭ҇и є҆ди́наго всели́лъ є҆сѝ: мене́ же свя́занаго въ мре́жахъ вра́жїихъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ тлѝ ѡ҆́наго сп҃си́:.
items.english_text: By the prayers of Lazarus, of Martha, and of Mary, make us worthy to behold Thy Cross and Thy Passion, O Lord, and the radiant queen of days, Thy Resurrection, O Lover of mankind!

items.english_text: Possessing maternal boldness toward thy Son, O all-pure one, despise not Thy kindred care for us, we pray thee; for thee alone do we Christians present unto the Master as an acceptable reconciliation!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Being true God, Thou knewest the falling asleep of Lazarus, and this Thou didst proclaim beforehand unto Thy Disciples, confirming, O Master, the boundless power of Thy Godhead!

items.slavonic_text: І҆́косъ. Оу҆ч҃никомъ Созда́тель всѣ́мъ предвѣ́ща гла́голя: Бра́тїѧ и҆ знае́мїи, на́шъ дрꙋ́гъ оу҆спѐ, си́ми предгла̀ и҆ оу҆ча̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ вся̑ вѣ́си ꙗ҆́кѡ Созда́тель всѣ́хъ. items.slavonic_text: Сѷнаѯа́ръ в Сꙋббѡ́тꙋ Пра́веднагѡ Ла́зара. Бл҃гословѝ Ѻ҆́тче прочестѝ. Сті́хи: Рыда́еши І҆и҃се: се чл҃чагѡ сꙋщества̀. Ѡ҆живля́еши дрꙋ́га твоего́: се Бж҃твенныѧ крѣ́пости.
items.english_text: *Ikos:*[^54] The Creator of all foretold unto His Disciples, saying: "Brethren and acquaintances, our friend hath fallen asleep!"—by these words foretelling and teaching that Thou knowest all things as Creator of all. *Ikos:*[^54]
The Creator of all foretold unto His Disciples, saying: "Brethren and acquaintances, our friend hath fallen asleep!"—by these words foretelling and teaching that Thou knowest all things as Creator of all. "Let us go therefore, and behold a strange burial, and the weeping of Mary, and let us see the tomb of Lazarus; for there I intend to work a marvel, accomplishing the divine predetermination, and granting Divine forgiveness unto all!"

items.english_text: On this same day we celebrate the resurrection of the holy and righteous friend of Christ, Lazarus of the four days. He was a Hebrew by race, of the sect of the Pharisees, and the son, as is found recorded in some accounts, of Simon the Pharisee, originating from the village of Bethany.[^56] When our Lord Jesus Christ was walking upon the earth for the salvation of our race, Lazarus was thus joined unto Him in friendship. For because Christ often conversed with Simon—who also inquired earnestly of Him concerning the resurrection of the dead—and frequently visited his house, Lazarus came to be dearly loved by Him, and not he alone, but also his two sisters, Martha and Mary. Now as the saving Passion was drawing near, wherein it was needful that the mystery of the resurrection be more clearly assured, Jesus was staying beyond the Jordan, having previously raised the daughter of Jairus and the son of the widow from the dead. But His friend Lazarus, being seized by a grievous illness, died. Jesus therefore, though not being there, said unto the Disciples: "Lazarus our friend hath fallen asleep"; and pausing a little, He said: "Lazarus is dead." Leaving the Jordan, He came unto Bethany, having been sent for by his sisters. Now Bethany is distant from Jerusalem about fifteen stadia or furlongs. And the sisters of Lazarus met Him beforehand, saying: "If Thou hadst been here, our brother had not died; but even now, if Thou willest, Thou canst raise him up, for Thou art able." Jesus then inquired of the people: "Where have ye laid him?" And straightway all went before Him unto the tomb. And when the stone was taken away, Martha said: "Lord, by this time he stinks, for he hath been dead four days." Jesus therefore, having prayed and shed tears over him that lay there, cried out with a loud voice: "Lazarus, come forth!" And straightway he that was dead came forth; and being unbound, he went away unto his house.

items.slavonic_text: ѻ҆трочи́ща и҆ вдови́ча сы́на въскри́въ и҆з ме́ртвы. Дрꙋ́гъ же є҆гѡ̀ Ла́зарь недꙋ́гомъ тя́жкимъ ѡ҆де́ржи́мъ бы́въ оу҆́мре. І҆и҃съ оу҆́бѡ и҆ не сы́й та́мѡ Оу҆ч҃никомъ гле́тъ: Ла́зарь дрꙋ́гъ на́шъ оу҆спѐ: и҆ ма́лѡ па́ки приста́въ: Ла́заръ, речѐ, оу҆́мре. Прихо́дитъ оу҆́бѡ въ Виѳа́нїю, І҆ѻрда́нъ ѡ҆ста́вль, ѿ се́стръ є҆гѡ̀ въ звѣ́ще́нъ бы́въ. Разстои́тъ же ѿ І҆ерл҃има Виѳа́нїа а҆́ки ста́дїй илѝ по́прищъ пятна́десятъ, и҆ предвстрѣто́стѣ се́стрѣ Ла́заревѣ глаго́лющѣ, а҆́ще бы є҆сѝ бы́лъ здѐ, не бы̀ оу҆́мерлъ на́шъ бра́тъ, но и҆ нн҃ѣ, а҆́ще тебѣ̀ хоти́телнѡ, въздви́гнеши и҆̀, мо́жеши бо. Въпроша́етъ же наро́да І҆и҃съ, гдѐ положи́сте є҆го̀; и҆ а҆́бїе всѝ предъидя́хꙋ на гро́бъ. И҆ ка́мени взя́тꙋ бы́вшꙋ Ма́рѳа гле́тъ: Гдⷭ҇и, оу҆жѐ смерди́тъ, четверодне́венъ бо є҆́стъ. Помоли́вся оу҆́бѡ І҆и҃съ, и҆ сле́зы на лежа́щаго и҆спꙋсти́въ гла́сомъ велі́имъ возва̀: Ла́заре, грядѝ во́нъ: и҆ а҆́бїе оу҆ме́рый и҆зы́иде. И҆ раздрѣше́нъ бы́въ ѿи́де въ до́мъ. Сїѐ стра́нное чꙋ́до на за́висть въздвиза́етъ Є҆вре́йскїа лю́ди, и҆ на Хрⷭ҇та̀ въздѣва́ются. І҆и҃съ же па́ки оу҆кло́нься ѿи́де. А҆рхїере́е же и҆ Ла́зара оу҆би́ти помышля́хꙋ, зане́ мно́зи є҆го̀ зря́ще къ Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ прилага́хꙋся: Но ѡ҆́нъ мысли̑мая разꙋмѣ́въ, къ Кѵ́прскомꙋ ѻ҆́стровꙋ и҆збѣга́етъ. И҆ та́мѡ пребыва́я, послѣ́жде ѿ А҆́пⷵловъ А҆рхїере́й пока́зꙋется Кѵті́искаго Гра́да. До́брѣ же и҆ Бг҃олюбе́знѣ пожи́въ, по три́десято лѣ́тно времени ѡ҆жи́тїа свое́го, оу҆мира́етъ па́ки, и҆ та́може погреба́ется, мно́гая чꙋдеса̀ содѣ́явъ.
items.english_text: This strange marvel stirred up the Jewish people unto envy, and they raged against Christ. Jesus therefore again withdrew and departed. And the chief priests took counsel to put Lazarus also to death, because many seeing him were believing in Christ. But he, perceiving their thoughts, fled unto the island of Cyprus. And dwelling there, he was later consecrated by the Apostles as Bishop of the City of Kition.[^57] Having lived worthily and in a manner pleasing unto God for thirty years after his revival, he died again, and was buried there, having wrought many wonders.
